Actor Yash's Film 'Toxic' Trailer Released, Generating Buzz

The trailer for actor Yash's upcoming film 'Toxic', directed by Geethu Mohandas, has been released. The film is described as a larger-than-life action thriller and a dark gangster drama. Reports indicate Yash plays a double role and that the film explores themes of love, power, and revenge. Yash has also entered film distribution with 'Toxic'. The trailer launch event was attended by cast members including Kiara Advani and Nayanthara.
